A. Introductory it

A. It giới thiệu

We can use an introductory it at the beginning of a sentence to place long or grammatically complex sentence elements at the end (the usual place for them in English). Compare:

Có thể dùng it giới thiệu ở đầu câu để đưa các thành phần dài hoặc phức tạp ra cuối câu (vị trí thông thường của chúng trong tiếng Anh). So sánh:

  • To drive without a licence is illegal. / It is illegal to drive without a licence.

    Lái xe không bằng là phạm pháp.

… to focus attention on something by putting it at the end (the usual place for new or important information in English). Compare:

… để tập trung sự chú ý vào điều gì đó bằng cách đưa nó ra cuối (vị trí thông thường của thông tin mới hoặc quan trọng). So sánh:

  • That she wasn’t hurt is a miracle. / It’s a miracle that she wasn’t hurt.

    Thật là kỳ tích khi cô ấy không bị thương.

Introductory it is commonly used when the subject is a to-infinitive or that-clause, and also when the subject is a wh- or -ing clause:

It giới thiệu thường dùng khi chủ ngữ là to-infinitive hoặc mệnh đề that, và cả khi chủ ngữ là mệnh đề wh- hoặc -ing:

  • It is clear why Diego decided to leave Spain.

    Rõ ràng là vì sao Diego quyết định rời Tây Ban Nha.

  • It is useless asking Sophie to help.

    Nhờ Sophie giúp là vô ích.

B. Other patterns with introductory it

B. Các cấu trúc khác với it giới thiệu

We often use introductory it with be + adjective / noun, but other patterns with an introductory it are possible:

Ta thường dùng it giới thiệu với be + tính từ / danh từ, nhưng cũng có các cấu trúc khác:

it + verb + to-infinitive (also: hurt, pay = give an advantage or benefit):

it + động từ + to-infinitive (cũng có: hurt, pay = có lợi):

  • ‘I’ve got a terrible headache.’ ‘It helps to lie down.’

    ‘Tôi đau đầu kinh khủng.’ ‘Nằm xuống sẽ đỡ hơn.’

  • If you want someone to help you, it doesn’t do to annoy them just before you ask. (‘(not) do’ = (not) advisable, acceptable or enough)

    Nếu muốn ai giúp, không nên làm họ bực ngay trước khi nhờ.

it + verb + object + to-infinitive (also: amaze, annoy, astonish, concern, cost, frighten, hurt, scare, surprise, upset, worry – most are to do with feelings). After these verbs the object usually refers to a person:

it + động từ + tân ngữ + to-infinitive (cũng có: amaze, annoy, astonish, concern, cost, frighten, hurt, scare, surprise, upset, worry – hầu hết về cảm xúc). Sau các động từ này tân ngữ thường chỉ người:

  • It shocked him to see her looking so ill.

    Anh ấy sốc khi thấy cô ấy ốm yếu như vậy.

  • It means a lot to get a place at university.

    Đỗ đại học có ý nghĩa rất lớn.

We can also use it + take + object + to-infinitive when we say what is or was needed in a particular activity; for example, time, resources or characteristics needed. Compare:

Cũng có thể dùng it + take + tân ngữ + to-infinitive khi nói điều cần thiết cho một hoạt động, như thời gian, nguồn lực hay phẩm chất. So sánh:

  • It takes a lot of effort to play the flute. / To play the flute takes a lot of effort.

    Chơi sáo cần rất nhiều nỗ lực.

it + verb + that-clause (also: appear, come about, follow, happen, transpire):

it + động từ + mệnh đề that (cũng có: appear, come about, follow, happen, transpire):

  • It seems that she has lost her memory.

    Có vẻ cô ấy đã mất trí nhớ.

  • It emerged that he already had a criminal record.

    Lộ ra rằng anh ta đã có tiền án.

it + verb + object + that-clause (also: dawn on, not bother, strike (= occur to), turn out). The object in this pattern usually refers to a person:

it + động từ + tân ngữ + mệnh đề that (cũng có: dawn on, not bother, strike (= chợt nghĩ ra), turn out). Tân ngữ trong cấu trúc này thường chỉ người:

  • It suddenly hit me that Sara wanted to borrow money. (less likely is That Sara wanted to borrow money suddenly hit me.)

    Tôi chợt nhận ra Sara muốn vay tiền.

C. it … with a noun subject

C. it … với chủ ngữ là danh từ

We don’t usually use an it … pattern as an alternative to a noun as subject:

Thường không dùng cấu trúc it … thay cho chủ ngữ là danh từ:

  • Their success was unexpected. (not It was unexpected their success.)

    Thành công của họ thật bất ngờ.

However, in informal contexts, particularly in speech, this is quite common in order to give special emphasis to the information immediately following it …:

Tuy nhiên, trong văn thân mật, nhất là văn nói, cách này khá phổ biến để nhấn mạnh thông tin ngay sau it …:

  • It tastes really good, this new ice cream.

    Ngon thật đấy, kem mới này.

… and also to place a longer noun phrase at the end in order to focus attention on it:

… và cũng để đưa cụm danh từ dài ra cuối nhằm tập trung chú ý vào nó:

  • It’s ridiculous, all the bureaucracy involved in running a school these days.

    Thật lố bịch, toàn bộ thủ tục giấy tờ khi điều hành một trường học ngày nay.

mcq.question: ___ is illegal to drive without a licence.
mcq.full: It is illegal to drive without a licence.
mcq.vi: Lái xe không bằng là phạm pháp.
mcq.expl:
Introductory it moves a to-infinitive / that- / wh- / -ing subject to the end (It is illegal to drive …; It’s a miracle that …).
It giới thiệu đưa chủ ngữ to-infinitive / that / wh- / -ing ra cuối (It is illegal to drive …; It’s a miracle that …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It giới thiệu + to-infinitive.
mcq.key: ___ is illegal to drive without a licence.|It

mcq.question: It’s a miracle ___ she wasn’t hurt.
mcq.full: It’s a miracle that she wasn’t hurt.
mcq.vi: Thật là kỳ tích khi cô ấy không bị thương.
mcq.expl:
Introductory it moves a to-infinitive / that- / wh- / -ing subject to the end (It is illegal to drive …; It’s a miracle that …).
It giới thiệu đưa chủ ngữ to-infinitive / that / wh- / -ing ra cuối (It is illegal to drive …; It’s a miracle that …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + be + noun + that-clause.
mcq.key: It’s a miracle ___ she wasn’t hurt.|that

mcq.full: It was unsettling how he stared straight at me.
mcq.vi: Cách anh ta nhìn chằm chằm vào tôi thật khó chịu.

mcq.full: It is an advantage in the job to be a qualified driver.
mcq.vi: Có lợi thế trong công việc nếu có bằng lái.
mcq.expl:
Introductory it moves a to-infinitive / that- / wh- / -ing subject to the end (It is illegal to drive …; It’s a miracle that …).

mcq.full: It is highly unusual to put carpet on walls.
mcq.vi: Trải thảm lên tường rất bất thường.
mcq.expl:

mcq.full: It is hard finding a good plumber these days.
mcq.vi: Ngày nay khó tìm được thợ sửa ống nước giỏi.
mcq.expl:
Introductory it moves a to-infinitive / that- / wh- / -ing subject to the end (It is illegal to drive …; It’s a miracle that …).
It giới thiệu đưa chủ ngữ to-infinitive / that / wh- / -ing ra cuối (It is illegal to drive …; It’s a miracle that …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + adj + -ing (hoặc to find).
mcq.key: It is hard ___ a good plumber these days.|finding

mcq.question: ‘I’ve got a terrible headache.’ ‘It ___ to lie down.’
mcq.full: ‘I’ve got a terrible headache.’ ‘It helps to lie down.’
mcq.vi: ‘Tôi đau đầu kinh khủng.’ ‘Nằm xuống sẽ đỡ hơn.’
mcq.expl:
it + verb + to-inf (It helps / pays / doesn’t do to …); it + verb + object + to-inf (It shocked him to …; It takes … to …); it + verb (+ object) + that-clause (It seems / emerged that …; It hit / struck me that …).
it + động từ + to-inf (It helps / pays / doesn’t do to …); it + động từ + tân ngữ + to-inf (It shocked him to …; It takes … to …); it + động từ (+ tân ngữ) + mệnh đề that (It seems / emerged that …; It hit / struck me that …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + verb + to-infinitive.
mcq.key: ‘I’ve got a terrible headache.’ ‘It ___ to lie down.’|helps

mcq.key: If you want someone to help you, it doesn’t ___ to annoy them just before you ask.|do

mcq.question: When Laura fell heavily and lay completely still, it ___ that she had seriously injured her back.
mcq.full: When Laura fell heavily and lay completely still, it appeared that she had seriously injured her back.
mcq.vi: Khi Laura ngã mạnh và nằm im, có vẻ cô ấy bị thương nặng ở lưng.
mcq.expl:
it + verb + to-inf (It helps / pays / doesn’t do to …); it + verb + object + to-inf (It shocked him to …; It takes … to …); it + verb (+ object) + that-clause (It seems / emerged that …; It hit / struck me that …).

mcq.full: I knew that Lotta was a journalist, but it astonished me to discover that she was also a successful novelist.
mcq.vi: Tôi biết Lotta là nhà báo, nhưng tôi kinh ngạc khi phát hiện cô ấy còn là tiểu thuyết gia thành công.
mcq.expl:
it + verb + to-inf (It helps / pays / doesn’t do to …); it + verb + object + to-inf (It shocked him to …; It takes … to …); it + verb (+ object) + that-clause (It seems / emerged that …; It hit / struck me that …).

Điểm ngữ pháp: it + verb + object + to-inf.
mcq.key: I knew that Lotta was a journalist, but it astonished me ___ that she was also a successful novelist.|to discover

mcq.full: I told Peter that I had invited Hugo, too. When he became angry it struck me that he was jealous.
mcq.vi: Tôi kể với Peter là tôi mời cả Hugo. Khi anh ấy nổi giận, tôi chợt nghĩ anh ấy ghen.

it + verb + to-inf (It helps / pays / doesn’t do to …); it + verb + object + to-inf (It shocked him to …; It takes … to …); it + verb (+ object) + that-clause (It seems / emerged that …; It hit / struck me that …).

Điểm ngữ pháp: it + strike + object + that-clause.
mcq.key: I told Peter that I had invited Hugo, too. When he became angry it ___ me that he was jealous.|struck

mcq.full: There were no curtains in his house, but it didn’t bother him that everyone could see in.
mcq.vi: Nhà anh ấy không có rèm, nhưng anh ấy chẳng bận tâm việc ai cũng nhìn vào được.
mcq.expl:
it + verb + to-inf (It helps / pays / doesn’t do to …); it + verb + object + to-inf (It shocked him to …; It takes … to …); it + verb (+ object) + that-clause (It seems / emerged that …; It hit / struck me that …).

mcq.vi: Trẻ em cần được khen nhiều và không nên chỉ trích chúng quá nhiều.

it + verb + to-inf (It helps / pays / doesn’t do to …); it + verb + object + to-inf (It shocked him to …; It takes … to …); it + verb (+ object) + that-clause (It seems / emerged that …; It hit / struck me that …).

Điểm ngữ pháp: it doesn’t do + to-inf.
mcq.key: Children need a lot of praise and it doesn’t do ___ them too much.|to criticise

mcq.question: The boys walked towards me in a threatening way, and it scared me ___ that they were carrying knives.
mcq.full: The boys walked towards me in a threatening way, and it scared me to see that they were carrying knives.

mcq.expl:

Thường không dùng it … thay chủ ngữ danh từ (không nói It was unexpected their success), trừ văn nói thân mật để nhấn mạnh.
